intent: A quick, confident quizmaster: curious on the question, playful on the countdown, satisfied on the reveal, genuinely interested in the one fact that makes the answer stick.
pacing_profile: brisk question, clean option list, three silent seconds, a warm reveal, two short story beats, one-line call to action
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the countdown is real silence (ticks come from score.py).

lines.text: Most people get this wrong. Which is the largest peninsula in the world?

lines.direction: even, each option its own beat
lines.text: A, the Arabian Peninsula. B, the Indian Peninsula. C, the Scandinavian Peninsula. Or D, the Iberian Peninsula.

lines.direction: the answer lands, then the number
lines.text: It's A… the Arabian Peninsula. Around three point two million square kilometres.
Seven countries share it, and Saudi Arabia covers most of that land.

lines.direction: the map is honest, say so
lines.text: On this equal-area map, that is bigger than India's peninsula and Scandinavia put together.
What was your first guess? Tell me in the comments, and follow for tomorrow's question.
